let internal_note_details = transforms.internal_note_details || "";

const genesys_interaction_id =
  typeof custom_field_31975964556050 !== "undefined"
    ? custom_field_31975964556050
    : "N/A";

let total_cost_pax_all = ZT.getVariableValue("total_cost_pax_all", "N/A");

selected_pnrs_final.forEach(current_pnr_final => {
  const passengersFormatted = (current_pnr_final.passengers || [])
    .map(p => `First Name: ${p.passengerFirstName}, Last Name: ${p.passengerLastName}`)
    .join("\n");

  const current_pnr_details = [
    { label: "Flexible Ticket", value: "hasFlexibleTicket" },
    { label: "Ticket status", value: "ticket_status" },
    { label: "New Flights", value: "new_flights" },
    { label: "Decision", value: "proceedHandling" },  
    { label: "Outcome", value: "outcome" },
    { label: "Customer Action", value: "customerAction" },
    { label: "System Cost", value: "system_cost" },
    { label: "Customer Cost", value: "cost_to_pax" },
    { label: "Customer's currency", value: "currency" },
    { label: "How rebooking was calculated", value: "calculation_method" },
    { label: "How rebooking was calculated", value: "calculation_way" },
    { label: "Pricing command used", value: "system_command" },
    { label: "EMD(s) to be transfered", value: "emd" },

    { label: "Farebasis", value: "farebase" },
    { label: "Fare difference and system currency", value: "fare_difference" },
    { label: "Trained on manual rebooking", value: "man_rebooking" },
    { label: "Tax difference and system currency", value: "tax_difference" },
    { label: "Airline's penalty and system currency", value: "yy_reb_penalty" },
    { label: "Waiver", value: "waiver" },
    { label: "Check-in cancelled?", value: "cancel_checkin" },
    { label: "GDPR Waiver exist", value: "gdpr_waiver" },
    { label: "Portal name", value: "portal" },
    { label: "Consolid exception", value: "consolid_exceptions" },
    { label: "PNR retrievable in the portal", value: "retrieve_pnr" },
    { label: "Alternative for flexible ticket offered:", value: "flex_alternative" },
    { label: "How to rebook due to FM", value: "fm_rebook" },
    { label: "Rebooking should be done by", value: "who_rebook" },
    { label: "Rebooking permitted", value: "reb_permitted" },
    { label: "Customer's currency", value: "customer_currency" },
    { label: "How customer will pay", value: "payment_method" },
    { label: "Payment received", value: "payment_confirmed" },
    { label: "Reason for escalation to support", value: "escalate_to_support" },

    { label: "New Return Date", value: "lastSegmentArrivalDate" },
    { label: "Persistent Button Outcome", value: "update_ticket_tag"}
  ];

  let pnr_note_details = `**Contact Reason**: Name Correction
**PNR**: ${current_pnr_final.pnr}
**Post Sales Handling**: ${current_pnr_final.postSaleHandleType}
**Passengers**:
${passengersFormatted}
`;


  pnr_note_details += current_pnr_details
    .filter(({ value }) => current_pnr_final[value] != null && current_pnr_final[value] !== "")
    .map(({ label, value }) => `**${label}**: ${current_pnr_final[value]}`)
    .join("\n");
